item.title: Houthis threaten Saudi Aramco facilities as government forces advance in Yemen
item.description: Yemen’s Houthi group warned civilians and employees to evacuate Saudi Arabia’s Aramco oil facilities on Tuesday, calling them “a legitimate target,” after the Saudi-led coalition ordered an evacuation near a Yemeni oil station in the Houthi-controlled capital Sanaa. item.title: South Korean stocks plunge 5.5%, stoking global chip fears
item.description: South Korean stocks plunged on Tuesday, with the KOSPI benchmark falling 5.5% to its lowest level in about three months and deepening a global selloff in chip stocks. item.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, its long-awaited frontier AI model
item.description: Google has finally released Gemini 4 Argon, its long-awaited frontier AI model, after months of trailing its rivals in the AI race. The company says Argon can compete with the best the industry has to offer, and it begins rolling out today to higher-tier Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app…

item.title: BioNTech mRNA cancer vaccine misses progression-free survival endpoint in Phase 2/3 trial
item.description: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 failed to improve progression-free survival (PFS) compared with Keytruda alone in a Phase 2/3 trial for patients with HPV16-positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), the German biotech announced Tuesday.
